title.zh: KOSPI erases an entire year’s worth of South Korean GDP
title.en: KOSPI erases an entire year’s worth of South Korean GDP

current_state.zh: South Korea's KOSPI index plummeted over 7.6% in one day, halting trading and capping a 40% drawdown from June that wiped out more than $2 trillion in market value, exceeding the nation's annual GDP.
